original_card.question: Can one reproducible environment or artifact-comparison failure be repaired?
methods: Reproduce one portability failure and add a minimal cross-environment fix.
Audit one canonical-payload comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Preserve immutable source hashes and proof-relevant content; a different compressed byte stream alone is not a mathematical mismatch.

first_step.inspect: Read the gzip-container reproducibility examples and distinguish frozen source bytes from regenerated payloads.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Reproduce one specific mismatch or audit one canonical comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Portable exact checks prevent environment failures from blocking valid contributions.
allowed_variations: One interpreter/version mismatch or one payload field comparison.
scope_change_triggers: Removing immutable-source pins because generated compressed bytes differ.

actual_scope: Audit PR1006 T37 receipt normalization over all eight-input digest permutations and provide an explicit path-to-role comparator that preserves relocation and every non-input receipt field.
scope_change_reason: The assigned method is a canonical-payload comparison audit. The concrete object is the eight-input provenance map in the accepted T37 bitmap adapter, distinct from gzip and Windows codec work.
bottleneck_link: Portable receipt comparison must preserve input identity associations so exact replay evidence remains reviewable across machines; engineering only, with no changed recursive cost or kappa.
stop_rule: One bounded receipt-comparison audit, no full-supplier rebuild or selected-frontier changes; finish about 00:17 UTC on 2026-10-14, hard stop 00:47 UTC, reserving verification and handoff time.
evidence: RESULT.json: 40320 legacy-equal permutations, 40319 strict rejections, one identity; both fresh complete T37 engines agree on 167832 roles, 333 calls and 14 inherited controls. Six focused test groups cover parsing, source and result corruption.
author: commdata2338
ai_assistance: Prepared for commdata2338 (@commdata2338), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in audit design, implementation, checking and writing. One agent; no independent human or subagent review.

open_questions.question: Should a future maintained T37 entry point adopt explicit input-role bindings for portable receipt comparison?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The old multiset normalizer erases path-to-digest association in saved evidence even though the current runner independently pins its actual inputs.
open_questions.first_step: Integrate receipt.py at a nonfrozen successor entry point and replay the unchanged reference and bitmap engines plus relocation and swapped-role controls.
open_questions.blocked_by: Maintainer adoption and a declared historical-layout policy; frozen predecessor code must remain unchanged.

passed_over.reason: Concrete receipt-role collision is bounded and independently testable without adding a performance claim.
